thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — we're prepping a Dedicated GPU pool expansion for Q3-24 in us-west-2 and eu-central-1. Need to kick off cloud account/service quota requests (GPUs, ENIs, EIPs, service quotas) and confirm cross-account role for the Dedicated billing account. Can @maria or @jordan take the lead on numbers?

maria: I can own the AWS service quota tickets. I'll need the forecasted max concurrent workers, preferred instance families, and desired headroom % by region.

jordan: I'll pull the traffic/latency maps and current utilization so we can argue for burst capacity. Heads-up — networking limits (ENI and private IPv4) are going to be the painful ones for us-west-2.

alex: Thanks. Initial ask from product: support a steady-state of 120 inference workers on A100-80GB equiv with 2x burst to 300 for launch weekends. For eu-central-1 start with 40 steady, burst 100. Suggest headroom of 20% for failures.

sam: FWIW, our cost model (baseline) for A100 spare = $X/hr per device; with reserved capacity commit we can reduce by ~25%. Finance wants a clear monthly burn delta before committing. @finance can you estimate rough monthly delta for the two regions if we reserve 40 A100-equivalents in us-west-2 and 10 in eu-central-1?

finance: Put a placeholder number: reserving 40 A100s in us-west-2 -> approx $Y/month (includes infra premium + 10% ops), 10 in eu-central-1 -> $Z/month. We need final SKU choice to nail exacts.

jordan: For quotas, here's what I'll ask ops to file: GPU instance quota (p3dn/p4d/h100 counts), EC2 On-Demand vCPU and ENI limits for the Dedicated account, Elastic IPs per region, and service-quotas for DescribeInstances API rate to prevent throttles during large scaleups.

maria: Drafting tickets now. Using AWS support type: Service Limit Increase. Template I'm using — feel free to copy:```
Subject: Request to increase service quotas for Redwood Dedicated account (account-id: 999999999999)
Region: us-west-2 (also opening eu-central-1)
Requested increases:
- EC2 GPU instance limit (p4dn.24xlarge or H100 equivalent): from 0 -> 50
- EC2 GPU instance limit (p3dn.24xlarge / A100): from 0 -> 80
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENI): from 500 -> 3000
- Elastic IP addresses: from 5 -> 200
- VPC route table entries / NAT gateway throughput: increase guidance requested
- DescribeInstances API rate quota bump (or guidance on burst policy)
Justification: Dedicated LLM inference pools for customer workloads with reserved capacity for PLG growth; we require headroom to support automated rollouts and burst weekends. Timeline: need initial quota increases within 10 business days to meet Q3 pilot.
Contact: maria@redwood.ai, phone: +1-XXX
```

alex: Nice. Add a line about cross-account role: we need an IAM role in the customer-managed Dedicated account with a trust policy to the Redwood infra account so our provisioning automation can create ENIs and attach instances. Also include VPC quotas (subnet IP counts) — we've hit /28s before.

maria: Good call. I'll add IAM role + Service Control Policy exceptions to the ticket and cc cloud-provider-ops.

jordan: For the burst plan, I recommend reserving a small warm pool (20 A100-equiv) that can be spun up in <5m via pre-warmed AMIs and ENI warm attachments. The rest can be interruptible/spot fallback. This helps keep the committed reservation lower while preserving SLOs.

sam: Tech question: can we reuse existing Amazon EC2 Capacity Reservations across accounts or do we need dedicated CRs per account? I remember cross-account reservations aren't supported, which implies we need separate reservations per Dedicated customer account.

jordan: Correct — Capacity Reservations are per account and AZ. We'll need to create them in their Dedicated account or use an auto-scaling warm pool strategy. Add that to the justification so AWS support sees why ENI + EIP limits must be higher.

alex: Who will file the eu-central-1 ticket? We should file both at the same time to reduce back-and-forth.

maria: I'll file both. Drafting now, will paste the ticket links once created. Expect initial case numbers in 30–60m.

devops-bot: [automated] New service quota case created: Case 1234567890 (us-west-2). Assigned to AWS Support SRE.

maria: Case 1234567890 (us-west-2) created. Also opened Case 1234567891 (eu-central-1). Pasted both into the internal tracker.

alex: Great. Next steps: Jordan to provide a one-pager with utilization and burst patterns, Sam + Finance to produce month-by-month cost delta for reserved vs on-demand, Maria to follow up on quota responses and add IAM/SCP text. I'll coordinate a 15-min sync tomorrow after we have case numbers.

jordan: I'll have the utilization doc and the sample autoscaling policy by EOD.

sam: Finance will produce a conservative and optimistic estimate — sending by EOD.

alex: Thanks all. If anyone thinks we should change instance families (e.g., H100 vs A100 mix) now's the time — otherwise we'll stick to A100-equivalent baseline and add H100 as a variant for high-throughput workloads. :thumbsup:
